hobby_cards.title: My Hobbies
hobby_cards.context: What I do during my freetime: 1) Gaming, 2) Writing Novels, 3) Hanging out with friends and 4) Netflix and Chill.

hobby_cards.title: 1) Gaming
hobby_cards.context: One of my first hobbies is Gaming. I have actually played games since I was young and my first exposure to games was Flash Games. Recently, the game I have been playing is a game called Ghost of Tsushima. The game takes place in 1274 on Tsushima Island, Japan, during the Mongol invasion. What I actually like about this game is the historical value it provides (I am a history buff) and how it provides a unique backdrop for historical games. Most historical games I see have Nazis as the common enemy for some reason. It's just boring to see almost every historical game involving Nazis. Instead, let's spice it up and add 13th-century Japan with the Mongols invading it. Not many people really know about 13th-century Japan compared to the Edo period of Japan. So yeah, having a historical game set in 13th-century Tsushima Island during the Mongol invasion really fascinated me. Disclaimer: No Mongolians were hurt during this game.

hobby_cards.title: 2) Writing Novels
hobby_cards.context: My second hobby is writing novels. And coincidentally, my novel fits into the 'Around The World' theme. If I could describe the novel that I am writing now, it would be mostly a blend of Korean webtoon + Japanese manga + different nationalities and cultures being involved in the novel. The summary of my novel is about people being stuck in purgatory where the whole world is being abandoned and to survive they need to play these deadly games that are based on the 7 deadly sins to survive. I love writing novels because it helps me express myself through writing and it also helps me write down my past experiences through the characters I write in the novel. Overall, I feel it gives my novel a personal touch :)

hobby_cards.title: 3) Hanging out with friends
hobby_cards.context: My third hobby is simply hanging out with friends. I love hanging out with my friends simply because I would like to be social with people and I also like to form great connections with others as well whether it's simply just having a simple meal together or playing a game together I find that spending time with friends helps me feel more connected to the world around me. It’s not just about having fun, but also about sharing meaningful conversations, exchanging ideas, and supporting each other through life's ups and downs. I enjoy the spontaneity that comes with hanging out—whether it's an unplanned late-night talk, an adventurous outing, or just relaxing together in a comfortable space. These moments create lasting memories and deepen the bonds I share with my friends. Beyond that, I believe that friendships are an important part of personal growth. Through socializing, I get to learn from others, gain new perspectives, and sometimes even challenge my own beliefs. Each interaction, no matter how small, adds to my understanding of people and relationships. At the end of the day, being with friends reminds me that life isn’t just about working hard or achieving goals, but also about cherishing the connections that make the journey more meaningful.

hobby_cards.title: 4) Netflix and Chill
hobby_cards.context: My fourth hobby is simply Netflix and Chill. I love watching Netflix simply because there are a whole load of variety of shows ranging from Western Movies to Korean Dramas to Japanese Anime. From La Casa De Papel to Squid Game, you are spoilt for choice with the number of greater shows to watch from all over the world. Also, watching Netflix and chilling also inspires and helps me to think up of ideas that I can write in my novels as well. And so with Netflix being kind of my backbone/supplement for writing novels, thus, I can say Netflixing and Chilling is included in one of my hobbies as well! :)
